name: coevolve
description: A closed feedback loop that turns how you actually work with Claude Code into a portable cowork profile — and then changes the harness so the lessons stick.

plugins.name: coevolve
plugins.description: Capture, curate, calibrate, distill, enact, verify. Records your AI-collaboration habits, failure lessons, and reusable patterns from real session transcripts, distills them into a personal playbook plus a portable cowork profile, then writes the high-severity lessons into rules and hooks and measures whether your behaviour actually changed.
